effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

levels.text:
Attacks 8 enemies in a 135°, 8m cone in front of Litria, from a distance of 2m, dealing 91 damage. Casts a [1% Burn] debuff on the targets, lasting 4s. The [Burn] ticks every 2s, damaging targets by 1% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 150% ATK). Also damages all of the target's allies in a 6m radius by 0.5% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 150% ATK).
Accuracy required for: Burn
#1 Damage: 140% ATK

bio: Litria is said to be formed of the memories of the Aspect of Light herself, Serenity. Invoked when Serenity needed aid the most, Litria has been by her side ever since - an eternal symbol of loyalty, hope, and righteous truth.
